name: Lineage or Legacy
source:
You take the role of a young man who was raised in the comforts of a rich family. Coddled by his mother, the protagonist lead a life of gratification and hence fell victim to obesity, callowness and lethargy. Due to this, the father had grown restless to his son's habits and constantly argued with him. One day, you had had enough resentment towards your father, and in your anger, you left home to pursue a higher education at LewSerr University. After leaving the comforts of your home, you will now face the hardships of life and attempt to find a place for yourself in this world.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Biting_The_Bullet]Patreon[/url]]
